# Local vendor assets

These are unchanged builds of the versions previously loaded by the application from CDNs:

- Bootstrap 4.6.2: CSS and bundled JavaScript from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@4.6.2/dist/`. MIT license in `bootstrap-LICENSE.txt`.
- Bootstrap's JavaScript bundle includes Popper 1.16.1. MIT license in `popper-LICENSE.txt`.
- jQuery Slim 3.5.1: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jquery@3.5.1/dist/jquery.slim.min.js`. MIT license in `jquery-LICENSE.txt`.

The adjacent `fonts/` directory contains Inter (400, 500, 600, 700) and Lora (400, 500, 600), downloaded from Google Fonts and losslessly packaged as WOFF2. Their OFL licenses are included. `css/fonts.css` maps files to their families and weights.
